svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: openav1 on the Alveo U200: 1080p decode speed
Frames per second on the same 548-frame clip, card and host end to end

circle.title: C01 2026-10-30 21:57: 1.2 fps checked. first full 548-frame decode; the host loads every frame's state through registers
C02 2026-10-31 02:24: 3.0 fps checked. the card loads and saves its own frame state (stage B)
C03 2026-11-02 08:48: 3.5 fps checked. raw-row read-back on the host
C05 2026-11-03 19:49: 9.2 fps checked. block-ahead prefetch and a second tile engine
C06 2026-11-03 20:09: 10.0 fps checked. faster motion-field loader and burst CDF save
C07 2026-11-04 11:20: 11.8 fps checked. reference ring of 8
C08 2026-11-09 04:06: 12.8 fps checked. filter passes pipelined (one tile engine image)
C09 2026-11-10 05:23: 14.8 fps checked. two patch words and two vertical groups a cycle (rungs A and B); kept on the card as u200-fm2rf8te2e90p-d3ba9fd after the run-record fix
C10 2026-11-10 20:52: 17.9 fps unchecked (16.3 checked). four registers on old paths; 100 MHz closes with 0 failing endpoints

C11 2026-11-11 15:38: 19.5 fps unchecked (17.4 checked). CDEF copied unfiltered blocks at three cycles a group (86 % of its cycles); now one a cycle; two timing registers (segmentation band and warp setup)

C12 2026-11-12 02:21: 20.2 fps unchecked (18.0 checked). the reference-fetch ring goes from 8 to 16 line buffers; it needed two timing fixes to close at 100 MHz (a local copy of the 2x-clock phase in the frame memories and a capture register in the motion-vector stack)

C13 2026-11-12 15:22: 21.2 fps unchecked (18.8 checked). the coefficient reader took ten cycles a coefficient on the big coded frames; the scan position is now read one ahead and a zero coefficient takes one cycle in the sign pass (step 1 of 2)
C14 2026-11-12 20:25: 21.3 fps unchecked (18.9 checked). step 2 of the coefficient reader: a level of 0 to 2 is stored in the cycle its symbol arrives (three cycles a coefficient in the level pass)

C15 2026-11-13 16:04: 25.2 fps unchecked (21.8 checked). the picture flush to memory streams a sample group a cycle and does not wait for each burst's response; deblocking of a superblock row starts when the row is decoded instead of a row later (intra prediction reads an unfiltered copy of the row's last line): the filter tail falls from 7.7 to 4.0 ms a frame and the tile phase from 39.1 to 35.7 ms

C16 2026-11-17 18:05: 27.3 fps unchecked (23.3 checked). the streaming filter chain replaces the three stage filters on the card (deblocking, CDEF and restoration run behind reconstruction at its rate: the wait for the frame after the last tile falls from 3.1 to 0.1 ms), with the output registers of the chain and four registers from a census of the near-critical paths (row store and motion-field write ports, the scaled-reference position multiply, a third dequant stage) that let it meet 100 MHz (WNS 0.017 ns, 0 failing endpoints)

C17 2026-11-19 22:28: 28.0 fps unchecked (23.9 checked). the motion field in the tile engines is a 32-row band projected just ahead of the decode instead of a whole-frame table filled before the first tile (block RAM 1,881 to 1,146 tiles); the host no longer waits for the projection; the old stage filters and the host-written frame state are gone
